build_facenet_model: build a FaceNet cascading heatmap model with VGG backbone and six CPM stages for face landmark detection
run_face_heatmap_inference: run face heatmap inference on an image using the Face class with a pre-trained model path
compute_face_landmark_peaks: compute face landmark peak coordinates from heatmaps using the compute_peaks_from_heatmaps method
review_facenet_forward_pass: review the FaceNet forward pass that returns a list of heatmaps from six cascading stages
refactor_face_inference_size: refactor the Face class to support configurable inference sizes of 368, 736, or 1312 pixels
